text: やっぱり…　そだてた　ポケモンの　ほうが　つよいんだな

structure.jp: そだてた　ポケモンの　ほうが
structure.en: Pokémon you've raised are the more

patterns.name: 〜のほうが
patterns.span: ポケモンの　ほうが　つよい
patterns.explanation: のほうが picks one side of a comparison as being more so. そだてた ポケモンの ほうが つよい = 'raised Pokémon are the stronger ones'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: そだてた　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. そだてた ポケモン = 'Pokémon that you raised'.

patterns.name: 〜んだ
patterns.explanation: んだ gives the feeling of having just understood how things are, and な shows he is saying it to himself. つよいんだな = 'so they really are stronger, huh'.
